messages:
Pam (Support): Hey team, escalating a customer report — since last JWKS rotation they've seen intermittent 401s when calling /v1/generate. Error in logs is 'invalid_signature' and 'kid not found' for a small % of requests. Happened ~15:45 UTC, looks correlated with a key rotation we did earlier.

Pam (Support): Customer uses Redwood-hosted auth (opensso) and caches JWKS on their side. They say simply retrying sometimes works. They're on Dedicated.

Kevin L: Can you paste a snippet of the raw auth header + verification error from our gateway logs?

Pam (Support): pasted logs below (redacted):

```
[2026-02-11T15:45:32Z] request_id=abc123 client_id=acct-789 path=/v1/generate auth_error=invalid_signature detail="kid\"A-rotated-key\" not found in cached JWKS"
[2026-02-11T15:45:33Z] request_id=abc124 client_id=acct-789 path=/v1/generate auth_ok=true verification_time=2026-02-11T15:45:33Z
```

Pam (Support): Customer says their middleware caches keys for 10min. They suspect race between our rotation and their cache.

Raj P: Not surprising. Two classic failure modes here: 1) client JWKS cache TTL too long so they keep using an old JWKS; 2) our rotation introduced a short window where kid is absent from published JWKS while old tokens still in flight. Also watch for clock skew causing tokens with nbf > now.

Kevin L: We have a JWKS rotation job that publishes new key then marks old as deprecated for 5 minutes before removal. Did that timeline run as expected? deploy-bot, show rotation deploy logs.

deploy-bot: JWKS rotation job triggered at 2026-02-11T15:44:58Z, new key published at 15:44:59Z, old key removed at 15:45:04Z, propagation to CDN edge started at 15:44:59Z.

Ashley M: CDN edge propagation can lag. If client cached the JWKS just before rotation we could see requests hitting a mix of CDN nodes — some with updated JWKS, some stale. If their client caches each URL separately, kid lookup could miss on nodes that dropped old key early.

Kevin L: Notes from gateway code: we cache JWKS in-memory per process with TTL 300s and refresh-on-401 if configured. For external clients, we honor cache-control but sometimes clients override. Our verification path currently fails fast on kid mismatch and returns 401; it does not attempt a fresh JWKS fetch on signature error (only on HTTP 401 from introspection). That might be the issue.

Raj P: Fix options: small change to verification flow — on signature verification failure that results in kid not found or signature mismatch, trigger an immediate background JWKS fetch and retry verification once. Also add 60s leeway to JWT library for iat/nbf/exp checks to account for clock skew.

Kevin L: Agreed. Quick patch: on err = kid_not_found OR signature_verification_failed then call fetch_jwks(force=true) and attempt verification one more time. Need to be careful to avoid thundering herd if many requests fail. Add per-process backoff (e.g., 1s -> 2s -> 4s) and a per-key TTL of 30s when rotation detected.

Pam (Support): Customer wants repro steps so they can confirm on their side. Can you provide exact curl and guidance?

Kevin L: Repro checklist for customer:
- Ensure a token signed with old kid exists (we can mint a short lived dev token for them).
- Force their client to call our /.well-known/jwks.json and cache it.
- Trigger rotation (we can simulate in staging) or provide a token with a kid that will be removed.
- Send repeated requests with that token across multiple nodes to surface cache inconsistency.

Kevin L: Example curl to mimic validation path (replace TOKEN):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

Kevin L: To simulate clock skew on linux:
```
sudo date -s "-120 seconds"
# run client request
sudo date -s "+120 seconds"
```

Pam (Support): Customer is happy to run the curl test and let us know. Meanwhile can we patch prod to reduce blast radius?

Ashley M: I'll spin a hotfix: gateway will attempt JWKS fetch+retry on signature errors with backoff; also increase default leeway to 60s. Plan: deploy to prod as a config flip on 2 small regions, monitor errors for 30m, then roll everywhere.

Raj P: Also log detailed failure reason (kid_missing vs signature_mismatch vs alg_mismatch) so we can triage faster. Add metric: signature_retry_count and jwks_refreshes_triggered_by_signature_error.

inc-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-2098 "Intermittent 401s after JWKS rotation" assigned to eng-runtime and eng-security. Priority: P2.

Pam (Support): Customer confirmed they use an in-house cache TTL=600s. We'll ask them to set a short TTL or refresh-on-401 as immediate mitigation. Also asked for their token sample; they provided a redacted JWT with kid=A-rotated-key.

Kevin L: Postmortem/long-term: consider making rotation additive: publish new key first and don't remove old key until a safe period longer than max clock-skew+max client cache time; or include a 'retired' flag in JWKS so clients can still find key for verification. Also public doc: advise clients to implement fetch-on-kid-miss.

Ashley M: Hotfix deployed to us-east-1a and eu-west-1a at 16:10 UTC. Observability: signature_retry_count spike then drop; customer reports error rate fell to 0.5% from 5%.

Pam (Support): Customer updated their cache TTL to 60s and enabled fetch-on-401 in their middleware. They report no 401s in the last hour. :tada:

Raj P: Follow-ups: 1) Add test harness that simulates JWKS rotation + distributed CDN nodes; 2) Add unit test for verification retry logic; 3) Update runbook with steps to force immediate JWKS fetch and to coordinate rotations with customer notification for Dedicated installs.

Kevin L: I'll open PR for gateway fix (verif-retry-1765) and link it in the incident ticket.

Pam (Support): Thanks everyone. I'll update the customer and close the escalation after 24h of healthy signals.

Ashley M: Quick note — also saw two unrelated errors where alg in JWT was ES256 while our server expected RS256; we return 400 in that case. Mention in runbook to check alg mismatch vs signature error.

Pam (Support): Closing loop: customer extremely appreciative of the quick fix. Adding summary to_INC-2026-2098 and will attach logs + repro steps.

Kevin L: Links: internal runbook https://redwood.internal/runbooks/jwks-rotation and PR draft https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/gateway/pulls/432

Pam (Support): marking this thread resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
